title: AI Slowdown Fears Shake Wall Street
description:
Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger and Isabelle Lee on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Tech stocks slide as new warnings call for slowing the AI race, while Wall Street braces for the Fed with inflation raising the stakes. Nissan's Christian Meunier says US auto tariffs were tough to navigate at first, but it helped the company expand its US footprint. Plus, Canada’s Prime Minister Mark Carney on reviving US trade talks.  Barclays CEO C.S. Venkatakrishnan on the forces squeezing global bond markets. And former DeepMind scientist Alex Turner on AI safety, while Nancy Tengler explains why the sell-off could be a buying opportunity.
